description: Eurostat high geographical resolution transport demand is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Transport demand > Eurostat high geographical resolution transport demand", published or maintained by ec.europa.eu (publisher inferred from the link). European NUTS-2 (281 regions in the EU) transport data Data is given for road freight transport air freight and passenger transport maritime freight and passenger transport rail freight and passenger transport for European NUTS-2 regions (in Germany: Federal states). It is not always clear directly from the data tables, what the numbers refer to e.g. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Transport demand" lists it under "Eurostat high geographical resolution transport demand". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
